Optomechanics: light interacting with high-quality mechanical nanoresonators for photonics, sensing and quantum technology.
Light-matter interaction, now mainly in semiconductors and materials for radiation detection.
Quantum computing, quantum machine learning, quantum optics.
Quantum physics, lasers and ultrafast spectroscopy.
